theme_description: Resource library site template with multi-level channel navigation, tag organization, advanced filtering, and comprehensive permission management and resource security.

logo_url.label: Logo image
logo_url.info: If a logo is set, the header shows the logo; otherwise it shows the site icon and site name.

head_html.label: Custom HTML in <head></head>
head_html.info: Supports HTML tags; typically used for analytics, support widgets, and other embed codes.

header_html.label: Insert HTML in the top navigation area
header_html.info: Supports HTML tags and limited Tailwind CSS styles; typically used for external navigation links, friend links, copyright/ICP info, etc.

footer_html.label: Insert HTML in the footer area
footer_html.info: Supports HTML tags and limited Tailwind CSS styles; typically used for external navigation links, friend links, copyright/ICP info, etc.

channel.name: Channel Page
channel.description: Used as a category directory for resources

thumb_url.label: Cover image
thumb_url.info: Shown on home channel cards; recommended aspect ratio 16:9

detail_open_mode.label: Open resources in detail page
detail_open_mode.info: When checked, opens the resource detail page; when unchecked, opens in-page (sidebar/modal)

hero_html.label: Hero section HTML
hero_html.info: Custom hero block at the top of the home main area; supports HTML and limited Tailwind CSS

show_channel_section.label: Show channel navigation cards
show_channel_section.info: When enabled, displays first-level channel cards with cover, title, description, and child page count

resource_download_expiry_time.label: Resource download link validity
resource_download_expiry_time.info: Unit: seconds; 0 means never expires. Preview image TTL is fixed at 7200 seconds.

api_host.label: API host
api_host.info: API host for batch upload and related features. If empty, it is inferred as open.* (e.g. open.baklib.com).
